note: Pin manifest for SparkInkling 0.4.1 (candidate), recipe linux-nvidia-dgx-spark-inkling2-mini-atlas version 1: Inkling 2 Mini on one DGX Spark. Engine adds the batched BF16 GEMV for decode batches and verifies of up to 8 rows (Strict RigMark short code C2 / C4 / C8 49.5 / 79.2 / 120.2 -> 52.7 / 81.9 / 122.7 on a development build), fixes tool calls at thinking effort 0 (the checkpoint opens such a call as a text block, which 0.4.0 returned as text when streamed), streams tool-call arguments as they are generated (with the tool guard off), runs a visit's Strict input projections as one launch, and adds budget forcing: once Inkling's reasoning passes its effort's budget or the loop watchdog fires, the engine closes it at a sentence boundary and the model answers. Requests that name no reasoning effort now reason at low (the template's own default is high). Image built from Enntity/sparkinkling next-0.4.1 and checked on one Spark: 8,786 engine tests passed; task probe 30/30 and 10/10 in both modes; tool calls streamed and whole, thinking on and off, in both modes; default effort 0.2. Its full RigMark release measurement is pending. image.reference is the GHCR manifest digest; the tag is the first 12 characters of the install/ tree.
